question: Estimate the IT infrastructure needed for IRCTC during Tatkal booking peak.
idealClarificationQuestions: Concurrent users at 10:00 AM Tatkal peak (most contested 60 seconds)? Yes.
Single peak day, average month? Average.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Tatkal seats released daily: ~80,000-1,00,000 across all trains pan-India.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Peak first-30-second concurrent users: ~70% of all tatkal-trying users hit at 10:00:00 = ~10 lakh concurrent.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: IRCTC must support ~1.2-1.3 million concurrent users in the first minute of Tatkal.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: supply ratio: ~10-15x = ~10-15 lakh users trying simultaneously.
~70% of all tatkal-trying users hit at 10:00:00 = ~10 lakh concurrent.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Plus general bookings + status checks etc. happening at same time

calculationFlow: Demand:supply ratio: ~10-15x = ~10-15 lakh users trying simultaneously.
Peak first-30-second concurrent users: ~70% of all tatkal-trying users hit at 10:00:00 = ~10 lakh concurrent.
Plus general bookings + status checks etc. happening at same time: ~2-3 lakh extra.
IRCTC must support ~1.2-1.3 million concurrent users in the first minute of Tatkal.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: IRCTC must support ~1.2-1.3 million concurrent users in the first minute of Tatkal.
